relationships.rationale: The selected contract makes a single provenance-preserving cross-branch proposal executable without merge.
Fifteen cases exercise source, target, authority, lineage, and reversibility invariants.
The deterministic validator rejects merge, auto-apply, authority collapse, overwrite, and source erasure.
A useful discovery remains a proposal until a human target decision authorizes application.
TurtleAsk likewise separates machine-side initiative from surfacing/interruption authority.
After governing one transfer, the next risk is cumulative de facto convergence across many individually valid transfers.

ctc_tags.rationale: A human target owner decides whether transferred material belongs in the inquiry.
The transferable artifact may be a question that opens inquiry rather than an answer.

ctc_tags.domain: Technology as Tool to Think With
ctc_tags.rationale: Branches and proposals become computational material without automatic synchronization.
Revision history may later support formative interpretation, but transfer is not a learning claim.
Humans may accept, rewrite, reject, or reinterpret the proposed perturbation.
Which ideas travel and whether they are framed as correction are power-bearing choices.
Sharing can move traceable difference without compulsory merge or consensus.

ontology_tags.rationale: A question from one branch can open another direction without erasing either trajectory.
Consequences discovered by inhabiting one world may become material for changing another.
Human decisions, Turtle proposals, world observations, and branch revisions recursively perturb inquiry.
A source branch can feed a later inquiry cycle while retaining its lineage.
Turtle transfer proposals remain inspectable material, not authority.
A failed or strange branch may still donate a generative question or constraint.
A room of possibilities can exchange material without collapsing into one canonical future.
Source branch, actor, upstream human source, proposal, target decision, and target revision remain distinguishable.

emergent_tags.rationale: Difference may travel as a proposal without becoming merge or correction.
Machine initiative may formulate an actionable candidate while human authority remains separate.
Canonical pointers and lineage can support collaboration without duplicating raw private source material.
Repeated individually valid transfers may still collapse plurality over time.

wait_a_minute.overlap: Noticing does not authorize interruption; forming an ask does not authorize surfacing; discovering useful branch difference does not authorize application.
wait_a_minute.why_it_may_matter: Machine initiative without automatic authority now recurs across three subsystems and may be a general TurtleBlock design principle.
wait_a_minute.uncertainty: The recurrence may remain an engineering principle rather than a distinct ontology concept; human scholarly judgment is required before promotion.

reconciliation_findings.reason: No authorized live D1 research-graph write path is available in this run.
Emergency fallback remains behind while normal runtime fetches canonical no-store Build Log and Next Edge feeds.
No authorized consent-safe visitor research read path was available.
Brand/share assets do not introduce a new research-bearing concept; avoid one-row-per-cosmetic-artifact churn.

uncaptured_observations.observation: Repeated individually legitimate transfers may create de facto convergence without any explicit merge event.
Reciprocal branch influence can be generative rather than erosive; preserving difference should not become an anti-collaboration purity rule.
Human rewriting of a transferred item creates a lineage relationship that may deserve later study as transformation rather than simple acceptance.

version_judgment.rationale: Evaluation/provenance strengthened, but coherent versioned model/config behavior required for v0.2 remains incomplete.
